outcome: Incidence of second-line procedures for PPH (vessel embolization, transfusion, hypogastric ligation)
cohort: Women who gave birth in 131 French maternity units between February and July 2011
finding: The incidence of postpartum hemorrhage was over-reported in the national hospital discharge summary database for vaginal deliveries but not for cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The database underestimated the incidence of vessel embolization and transfusion among vaginal deliveries and of hypogastric ligation, other vessel ligation, and transfusion among cesareans.
